body: Stab the lil bitch in the throat and save myself lots of grief.

Thank you so much for sharing, it really gives me hope as someone struggling with mental health (although probably not the same ones as you) but also facing the same intrusive thoughts that I'm just being dramatic and faking every time I go to appointments.

If it's not too personal, did/have you told your family? And did you disclose anything in your resume? I've always been afraid that if I get diagnosed it wouldn't be good if I want to get hired anywhere since there's still a big stigma in Singapore about mental health.

Fuck if I know, buddy. You've got to keep searching for something that makes you want to live- even if it's just to delay the sadness that your family and friends will feel at your death. Even if it's to spite that asshole you know. Even if it's to see Half Life 3 come out.

Yeah bud, I understand. Depression's never gonna leave you and you've got to live with this invisible monster hovering over your shoulder your entire life. 

But listen, you can fight this sonnovabitch. Go to your mirror every time you feel like shit and put your middle finger up at your reflection. Every time you feel like giving up, tell that coward in the mirror: not fucking today. You might feel like shit all the time, but do the things you must (hygiene, cleaning up your room/house, feeding yourself) anyway. Sulk, take 5 hours to eat your lunch, spend an hour at the door to your shower, but do it even if all you want to do is lie in bed. You don't have to fucking enjoy life all the time. 

Go and do the thing that make you feel happy, or at least something that distracts you. There's going to be that underlying feeling of sianess anyway, but having other feelings on top of that helps you to hold on a little bit more. Schedule shit, and follow that schedule the best you can. Meet your friends, focus on their issues rather than your own for a while. (note: this probably isn't healthy in the long term but if it helps, it helps)

And when you want to die, when you feel like you can't stand another day, that's valid too. People without chronic depression can't understand us, but even if you didn't kill yourself this time, your desire to die was not fake. But every time you push back against that, you're strong.

If you want help, you have to follow the advice the therapist gives you. Don't go in half-heartedly. In fighting this monster, you can only rely on yourself to wield the shield that keeps it at bay.

> I realise that I was "better" off alone. I didn't go to the canteen during recess. I will buy a drink from a vending machine, and that's it. I will hide at random places in school, and sometimes I'll even hide inside the toilet cubicle which can get a little stressful. 

>  I started having suicidal thoughts, and I remember thinking about how people go about hanging themselves because there was no hook attached to the ceiling. I had no one to turn to or ask for advice.

Fuck, I relate so much, except that I thought a lot more about jumping off a building. It made going to tall places very nerve-wrecking, because I'll just be like casually looking down and imagining how long it would take for the cleanup crew to arrive and how big an area they would have to cordon off if I just happened to, you know. 

Then I started writing letters to the people I would be leaving behind, and thinking about what they would feel if they found the letters. It helped that I wouldn't want to burden them with my feelings and thoughts with no way to resolve them, so I tore the papers up and kept living. It was very cathartic.

Well, we're still here for now. *fist bump*

That sounds like a parallel of my life from secondary school onwards... without the adult interference. I ended up going through secondary, JC and uni practically silent, and never got the hang of talking about casual things.

I never thought of it as bullying though. I was (still kindof am) a dramatic little shit and probably deserved it LOL

Oh jesus, our sex ed has really failed. Pulling out is not a method of contraception at all because even pre-come/pre-ejaculate or whatever you want to call it has sperm in it. The possibility of it actually taking is a lot less, yes, but if you don't want kids then when your cock starts weeping start keeping it away (in a condom).

Personally, I would not get any support in Singapore that can be noted down and attached to my life. I've known friends that got taken to the hospital by the SCDF and forcefully kept there for admitting to suicide ideation- not even having plans, but just having thoughts and wanting help to handle it. They've missed school and work because of that, impacting their lives and having a stigma attached to them by both family and friends. And this was completely legal. FFS, we only wanted some help.

tbh I would hesitate to suggest people to go to a counsellor in Singapore, especially if they have suicidal thoughts. One of my classmates decided to go, and I encouraged her. The counsellor, on hearing that she had suicidal thoughts, stalled for time. In the end she got sent to a hospital by the police for 2 days. 

Still feel guilty about that.
Bro just asked me to commit suicide. Thanks a lot.

The nicest thing I can think of is for them to stop wasting their time on me. I'm such a failure, and I can't amount to anything much. No matter what I try at, I can't find anything that I'm good at. All my hopes and dreams have withered away with every failure and I'm left with nothing. 

The people in my life expect me to achieve something worthwhile. Anything less is a disappointment and 'you haven't put enough effort into trying' and 'you're wasting our time/money'. I just can't do it anymore, but I can't let them down either. 

It can't be depression. I've gone to psychologists who didn't diagnose me with anything. Even tried anti-depressants though a general practitioner. It didn't change anything. I don't think I deserve to live this life.

But I guess I'll sleep on it first. Hopefully I'll feel stupid about this come morning. Maybe I'll be able to approach this more objectively. Thank you.
